units: <cite ref="Gittin 23b:8">Gitt. 23ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 25a:64">Tem. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אם היתה ע׳ זכתה לו</he> if she (the slave) was with child (at the time of the emancipation of herself and her eventual issue), she can accept the privilege for it.

<cite ref="Yoma 82b:2">Yoma 82ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ההיא ע׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00615"><he>רִיחַ</he></cite> ch. Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 4 <cite ref="P00068"><he>עֻבָּרָה</he></cite> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="T00615"><he>רִיחַ</he></cite> h.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עוּבָּרוֹת</he>.
